assessment: Linux entered s2idle for most of the backpack trip but resumed three times with the lid closed. User reports the laptop was hot. Low hardware power consumption is not established.
timing_method: For each kernel PM entry/exit pair, subtract the journal CLOCK_MONOTONIC difference from the realtime difference. Approximate software timekeeping suspension, not physical low-power residency; subject to clock corrections and journal timestamp granularity.

battery_samples.role: Last saved pre-trip charge reading, not an energy sample at lid closure.

battery_limit: Seven percentage points between saved readings, but the endpoints do not bracket the trip and no exact Wh endpoints were captured. Do not report isolated suspend wattage.

thermal_observation.limit: Post-trip readings with AC connected; these do not measure peak temperatures inside the bag.

wake_cause: Not established. Current pm_wakeup_irq=72 is the last resume, aligned with lid reopening, and cannot identify the three earlier wake causes.
notable_logs: NVIDIA power-source change status 0x11 at 08:57:32.900936 during the first closed-lid resume; relevant clue, not proof of its cause.
The known already-free IRQ warning and queueing ieee80211 work while going to suspend occurred earlier this morning.
This boot has six recorded successful suspend operations and zero recorded failures. These counters do not imply uninterrupted sleep or low hardware power draw.
No new boot or overnight-style unrecoverable hang occurred during this trip.
followup: Capture wake causes across every resume, exact battery-energy endpoints, and available platform low-power residency. Repeated waking and excess sleep power must be investigated separately. Use shutdown for backpack transport while heat and sleep reliability remain unresolved.
